dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Hereditary spinocerebellar ataxia (SCA), cause: autosomal dominant CAG-repeat polyglutamine expansion — most likely SCA type 6 (CACNA1A), pending genetic confirmation.

1. Sporadic adult-onset cerebellar ataxia (SAOA) — a diagnosis of exclusion once an inherited cause is ruled out
2. Multiple system atrophy, cerebellar type (MSA-C) — would need to see autonomic failure, hot-cross-bun sign, or pontine atrophy
3. Chronic alcohol-related cerebellar degeneration — would need a history of sustained heavy alcohol use and is typically confined to the anterior vermis
